title: Tamsin and the Scholarship
author: Petra Almeida
blurb: Dominic Eastwick, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
